contract.unpack: Separate fixed rootless new-package profile; successful complete inventory, safe source parents and all source/payload destinations absent. External preflight refuses all recorded manager history. Incoming install without previous version accepts only this version/architecture half-installed row; unpack only, never preparation authority.
contract.existingOnly: Exact installed bytes/ownership/modes/single links/parents precede the fixed native check. Configure, repeated configure and supported abort branches invoke check only, then licensing startup and app registration. No initializer fallback, reset, adoption, cleanup or original helper/engine startup command.
contract.preservation: Check failure prevents startup and registration, leaving missing/partial/unknown/consumed state intact. Removal/deconfiguration stops licensing only and preserves source data. Upgrade refuses before effects; no postrm or image-policy migration.
contract.archive: Only regenerated canonical lifecycle controls accepted. Source-state payloads, escaping paths, writable modes, mismatched modes, missing required inputs and dependency header injection are rejected.
contract.authority: Independent external first-preparation transaction/issuer/history NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Ordinary configure, absence, failed check and complete anchor disappearance never provide first-install/reset authority. This candidate is private and cannot pass the unchanged upgrade-only release gate.
contract.limits: Cooperative instantaneous shell observations, not a lock across dpkg or loaded launchd job ownership/lifetime authority. Inert checker results prove shell ordering/preservation, not native prepared-state validity or actual dpkg/customer installation.
